entities.summary: Jake Neighbours is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a winger and alternate captain for the St. Louis Blues of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted by the Blues in the first round of the 2020 NHL entry draft with the 26th overall pick.
